dsh-peak-cost-mode 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

posts.en:
dsh-peak-cost-mode is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f01e273e5e18161818ef.html
